The problem we keep finding

The pieces exist. Nothing connects them.

Content, a profile, an offer, DMs, sales calls. Almost every business we meet has all of it. Nobody can say which piece produced a real conversation, so decisions get made on feeling instead of evidence.

AttentionInterestIntent QualificationConversationBooked call

Real working documents from one build. Shown at a distance on purpose.

ISOPROF

Roof and facade renovation and insulation

€2,000,000 a year in revenue, falling, and almost no control over where the next job came from.

Where they were stuck

Tens of thousands a year on ads and bought lead lists.Real money out every month. A bought lead goes to three or four competitors at once, so he was paying for a coin flip.
The sales team called people they knew nothing about.A name and a rough location. Not the roof type, the size, the budget or the timing. Every call began from zero.
Two million became one and a half.Half a million in turnover, gone in a year. With nothing measured, the only answer left was to spend more.

If your distribution costs money every month and you still cannot say what it bought you, the outcome is the same one he had.

What we built

We rebuilt the road from a video to a qualified request. Content that leads somewhere, a step in the middle that does the qualifying, and a request that arrives with the whole picture attached.

ContentIdea, script, filming, edit. Made to lead somewhere.
Next stepA reason to act worth more than "message us".
Self assessmentThey work out how serious their situation is.
TrustReviews and proof before anything is asked.
Sales teamThe request lands with the full context attached.

The profile, piece by piece

01

The name field

It said ISOPROF and nothing else. That field is what gets searched. We put what he does and where he does it into it, so the right people can actually find him.

Before

The bio

Dry and vague. It left out everything that builds trust: the volume of work behind the business, the family business in Aartselaar, what he actually does. All of it existed. None of it was on the page.

Random work photos. No questions answered, no reviews, no explanation of what happens if you call. We rebuilt three into seven that each carry weight.

What the highlights do now

Every bubble now answers something: a question, a doubt, what it is like to work with him, or proof that he has done it before.

antwi.bridal

Custom bridal and traditional / evening wear

She was posting to post. Three to twenty thousand views, every time.

Where she was stuck

Content with no direction is just noise.She posted because posting is what you do. Nothing tied one video to the next, so she kept pulling in the wrong people.
The views were real. Nothing was done with them.Nobody tracked why a video worked or who it reached. So the attention arrived, sat there, and left again.
A strong name, not being used.A high value product, and a profile that worked as a display case instead of a path. Someone could land, like it, and leave.

Posting and hoping is not a strategy. It is the absence of one.

Then the first video we made went out

140KViews on the first video with us. Her normal range was 3K to 20K
1,020+New followers from that one video
€160,00040 inbound enquiries on a €4,000 product. Without a next step in the video

Her feed before. This is the normal range she was working in.

And the first video we made, sitting in the same feed beside 4,662 and 4,607.

The full picture from that video. The most comments and likes she had ever had. She posted it herself with the note “my first video with AS Media”.

Ray

Marketing for commercial solar companies

He only wanted videos. We told him that would not be enough. He found out himself, and then he came back.

Where he was stuck

He wanted content but knew nothing about content.He wanted us to script and edit, and stop there. The ideas, the direction and the angles stayed with him.
So we made him 21 posts, and not much came out.The work was fine. The result was not. No path, no capture, no follow up, so the attention landed nowhere.
He was cold calling and hoping.Every month started at zero. Finding people was still a personal, manual job, and it stayed that way no matter how much went out.

Content without a system is the most expensive way to learn this lesson. He learned it, and then he fixed it.

Then he bought the system, and we rebuilt the business

Not more videos. A full acquisition system, from a stranger seeing him to a booked call.

A sharper ICP

His targeting was effectively "solar panels". We narrowed it to commercial solar companies with real revenue, where one client is worth enough to justify the work.

An offer with levels

He had one weak offer. We rebuilt it around what his ideal client is actually struggling with, then split it into levels.

A lead magnet that qualifies

Not a random PDF. It gives the reader real value, and tells us who they are and what they need on the way through.

Sales assets and lead magnets

Material that works between conversations, so a prospect keeps moving without him chasing. We taught him to build them himself too.

The profile now, rebuilt around one clear promise.

The twenty one posts. Good work, and it brought him almost nothing, because there was no system waiting behind any of it.

1 / 2

The lead magnet we built him

Confidential — this is the strategy itself, so it stays blurred.

A prospect answers eight questions about his own business, sees what the numbers add up to, and hands over his situation on the way through. This is the piece the twenty one posts never had behind them.

From cold calling and hoping, to a funnel that can turn a viewer into a customer.

Karim

Marketing for bathroom installers

Cold calling was working. The problem was that nobody had heard of him.

Where he was stuck

No content meant no name.The calls landed, but there was nothing behind the name when someone looked him up. On outbound, that ceiling arrives fast.
His niche runs on trust.People need to see that you know what you are doing before they will speak to you. He had the knowledge. None of it was anywhere.
Every month started from zero.Outbound only pays while you are dialling. Nothing he did in January made March easier, because nothing stayed behind with his name on it.

You can be good at what you do and still lose deals because a stranger cannot verify it in ten seconds.

What we did

He wanted to post for a full month straight. We built more than twenty videos for him end to end: ideas, scripts, filming and editing.
